name: Evening Train
source:
You drift off on the evening train home. When you open your eyes, a stranger occupies the seat opposite… and a night of violence begins.

[From [url=https://tokiko220.itch.io/evening-train]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你在晚上回家的火车上昏昏欲睡。当你睁开眼睛时，对面的座位上坐着一个陌生人……暴力之夜开始了。

[来自[url=https://tokiko220.itch.io/evening-train]Itch.io[/url]]
